basic_details.job_title: IIT Jammu Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Jammu is filling one Research Associate (RA) post on the funded project "Low-cost Prosthetics Design and Fabrication using Advanced Textile and Composites Technology", sanctioned by the National Technical Textiles Mission (NTTM). The consolidated salary is ₹49,000 per month plus HRA as applicable, initially for six months. The essential qualification is a Ph.D. in the relevant or allied discipline with a B.E./B.Tech. in a listed branch. The upper age limit is 35 years. Applications are uploaded on the online portal https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/ by 31 December

vacancy_details.details: The notice announces one position of Research Associate (RA) in the area of Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Communication, Materials Engineering, Biomedical Engineering.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Jammu Research Associate (RA) Post
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Jammu is located at Jagti, NH-44 Nagrota Bypass, Jammu. The post is attached to a research project led by Prof. Durai Prabhakaran R T of the Department of Mechanical Engineering. The project is funded by the National Technical Textiles Mission.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces one position of Research Associate (RA) in the area of Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Communication, Materials Engineering, Biomedical Engineering.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable qualifications: Prior experience of having completed one research project is highly desirable. Four research publications in a peer reviewed journal as First author is highly desirable. Age limit: upper age limit is 35 years. It is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/women and physically handicapped candidates. The notice prints no date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in the relevant or allied discipline, with B.E./B.Tech. in Electronic Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), or Computer Engineering with Sensors Technology from a recognized University/Institute.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated salary is ₹49,000/- per month plus HRA as applicable, as per approved project funds. The notice states there is no enhancement in salary, and no further enhancement as per the latest government norms for the Research Associate position. The tenure is initially six months. It may be extended based on performance or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Research Associate (RA) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate must be able to perform sensor and hardware design, and conduct experimental and clinical trials. The selected candidate should work 15% of the work at AIIMS Rishikesh, Department of Orthopedics, with Professor Roop Bhoosan Kalia.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Jammu Research Associate (RA)
content_sections.text: Open the application portal at https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/ . Use the RA tab on the portal, as the notice directs. Upload the duly filled application form with the requested details. Upload scanned copies of certificates and other supporting documents, including all documents for educational qualification, experience, etc. Give valid e-mail IDs and phone number in the application. Apply by 31 December 2026. Documents named in the notice: Duly filled application form Scanned copies of certificates and other supporting documents Documents for educational qualification, experience, etc. At the interview: updated CV and original and attested photocopies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualifications

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Merely possessing the prescribed qualification does not ensure a call for interview. Candidates may be shortlisted based on merit and need for the project. Only shortlisted candidates will be called, and they will be informed by e-mail about the interview and its time. The interview will be held using the online/offline platform. The interview date is not given in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, other documents and photographs submitted. Candidates not able to show work progress will pay back two month salary as penalty. Candidates who are already employed should produce a relieving certificate from their employers if selected. Queries can be directed to the Principal Investigator, Prof. Durai Prabhakaran R T, Indian Institute of Technology Jammu, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Jagti, NH-44 Nagrota Bypass, Jammu, 182211. Email: [email protected]
